summary: A single piezo counter (191) that ran from Feb 2019 to May 2022. The long all-zero outages (1 Apr-12 May 2019, 18 Oct-14 Nov 2021) are correctly set to missing. The near-zero period from 16 May to 24 Jun 2019 is real: site 183 at the same spot also fell to near zero while site 185 rose. The fall from ~150-250 to ~30/day from 1 Apr 2021 is also real, because riders moved to the new north-bank path (site 195 opened at ~500/day while site 182 fell). Only a few short zero_outage fixes on wet, low-volume days are restored.
